annotation.title_clean: Exploring the Roles of Robotics in Shaping Society 5.0: Challenges, Opportunities and Ethical Implications
annotation.title_en: Exploring the Roles of Robotics in Shaping Society 5.0: Challenges, Opportunities and Ethical Implications
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ogbaga, I.N.; Ezeanya, C.U.; Igboji, K.O.; Nwafor, C.A.
annotation.venue: Computing, Information Systems, Development Informatics & Allied Research Journal
annotation.summary_en: Exploratory literature review (15 of 156 papers, 2016–2024) on robotics in Japan-originated Society 5.0, covering healthcare, smart cities and sustainability. It identifies technical, acceptance, economic and ethical challenges (privacy, data security, job displacement) and calls for regulatory frameworks and interdisciplinary collaboration.
key_provisions_or_claims: Robotics can improve healthcare, smart city services, agriculture and sustainability in Society 5.0.
Challenges include technical/infrastructure barriers, societal acceptance, economic constraints.
Ethical concerns centre on privacy, data security and job displacement.
Calls for regulatory frameworks and interdisciplinary collaboration to ensure human-centred robotics.
